summary: Frontend-only verification of (A) Driver Hub redesign with bottom nav + Quotation sub-tabs + 7-day filter + Message tab, and (B) Customer /jobs deposit-choice gating on the Accept button. All 6 items from the review request passed.
tests_executed: Driver bottom nav: driver-bottom-nav present with all 4 buttons (dnav-quotation, dnav-accepted, dnav-message, dnav-settings). Old top-tab testids (driver-tabs, dtab-*) are all absent (0 matches).
Quotation sub-tabs: qsub-open + qsub-waiting both present. qsub-open shows driver-available-list; clicking qsub-waiting hides it and shows driver-waiting-list.

Day filter: driver-day-filter present with 8 day buttons (day-all + 7 day-YYYY-MM-DD). Clicking a specific day (day-2026-09-30) applies bg-primary (purple selected) class. All button switches list back to all jobs.

Message tab: dnav-message shows driver-message-list with conversation-<booking_id> entries for accepted jobs (1 conversation seen for drv1@example.com). Tapping opens a chat modal (role=dialog present).
Settings tab: driver-settings, driver-availability-toggle, pricing-editor, documents-uploader all render as expected.

Customer deposit gating on /jobs (customer@example.com, MWV3BF4AD59 active booking, 5 driver offers): pay-deposit and pay-full both un-selected initially (neither has border-primary class). All 5 accept-<driver_id> buttons are disabled with label 'Choose payment first'. After clicking pay-deposit, button enables with label 'Accept — £15.00' (15% of £100). After clicking pay-full, label switches to 'Accept — £100.00'. Selected pay button shows border-primary.
critical_code_review_comments: MyJobs.jsx line 288: <Button onClick={() => onChat && onChatUnavailable()} ...> — dead expression (calls the no-op onChatUnavailable regardless; the button is also permanently disabled). Harmless but confusing; remove or make it a real 'Message unavailable until accepted' tooltip.

DriverDashboard.jsx line 92-103: dayOptions is memoized with an empty dep array; if the page is left open past midnight the day buttons will remain on yesterday's date. Low impact but consider re-computing on focus.
